text:
sasha: Hey people-ops — quick Q. I'm visiting my parents in Spain next week and they rented a rollator for my mom. The provider billed as out-of-network. Is DME rental covered when the supplier is outside the US? Any pre-approval needed? cc @ben
people-ops: Hi @sasha — short answer: maybe. It depends on your plan and whether this was a medical necessity vs elective. We usually need prior auth for DME rentals; for emergency/retro cases the insurer sometimes grants retroactive approval. You'll need the itemized invoice + physician medical necessity note.
ben: Please open a claim with the insurer now so there's a record. In practice: get an itemized rental agreement, the HCPCS/CPT code (ask the supplier — e.g., E0143), and a signed MD note stating why rental is necessary.
jordan: FYI we had a similar case last month — they got reimbursed after submitting receipt + proof of payment + prior auth request within 90 days. :thumbsup:
maria: Steps I used: 1) ask supplier for an itemized invoice showing daily rate & total rental period, 2) get HCPCS code, 3) have the treating doc fill out the DME prior auth form, 4) submit via the benefits portal and also call the insurer to log it.
people-ops-bot: Helpful links: Benefits portal -> https://benefits.redwood.com (Claims > Submit DME). Prior auth form: https://benefits.redwood.com/forms/prior_auth_dme.pdf. Insurer phone: 1-800-555-1212 (have member ID ready).
ben: If insurer denies because supplier is out-of-network we can help escalate with a medical necessity appeal. Attach the claim number and cc people-ops@redwood.com when you submit.
sasha: Thanks — I'll upload the invoice and MD note. Insurer gave me a tentative claim # 88776655 over the phone. I'll DM the screenshot of the invoice.
insure-bot: Automated note: For reimbursement, upload receipts within 90 days of service. For rentals longer than 30 days, insurer requires a monthly rental agreement and may convert to purchase after a specified period. Retro prior auths considered for emergencies only.
jordan: Ping me if you want me to proof the submission before you hit send.
sasha: Done — filed online and called the number. DM'ed the invoice. Appreciate the help :heart:
